# 25% discount on everything in our merchandising shop! Only on June 21, 2024!

Our merchandising shop offers you a big discount promotion: **25% OFF everything on** **June 21, 2024**

The Merchandising Shop is another channel to **support** us and **donate** in this form. In return you get cool shirts, sweaters, mugs and much more with a funny (perhaps ironic) saying or the Nuka Knights logo. If you have ideas for other sayings and motifs, please write in the comments.
